paragraphs: Rav Acha of Difti spoke to Ravina before Rava, first chapter of Yevamot 8a. They voted to make him academy head, but it did not succeed; Tavyomi then became head, Bava Batra 12b. Therefore he said, Merubbeh 80b, “One to whom harm is done is never favored,” etc. It is not so: he spoke from his distress. Beginning of Sheloshah She'akhalu 45b: Yehudah bar Meremar, Mar bar Rav Ashi, and Rav Acha of Difti were equal in wisdom. Rav Acha bar Tachlifa; Rav Acha bar Ika. He asked Ravina, “Is this what Rava was asking?” Nazir 42a.
